parameters.description: Byte containing the virtual key code of the key to simulate.
parameters.name: bVk

parameters.description: Specifies the state of the key. It is any combination of the following values: Value Description KEYEVENTF_KEYUP If this flag is set, a call to SendVirtualKey generates a WM_KEYUP message. If this flag is not set, a call to SendVirtualKey generates a WM_KEYDOWN message. KEYEVENTF_SILENT If this flag is set, the key the user pressed to activate SendVirtualKey does not make a keyboard click sound, even if clicks are enabled on the device.

documented_values.description: If this flag is set, a call to SendVirtualKey generates a WM_KEYUP message. If this flag is not set, a call to SendVirtualKey generates a WM_KEYDOWN message.
If this flag is set, the key the user pressed to activate SendVirtualKey does not make a keyboard click sound, even if clicks are enabled on the device.
